question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: Q4 FY27 GAAP opex guide is set by: FY27 opex growth in the 'low 50s' (Kress, Q2 call) on a restated FY26 non-GAAP base of $22.82B (16.694 + 6.125 SBC). Q1-Q3 non-GAAP total about $24.68B (7.449, 8.232, 9.0 guide), so 50-54% growth implies Q4 non-GAAP of $9.55-10.46B; adding the roughly $0.2B GAAP gap gives $9.75-10.65B. Sequential guides went 7.7, 8.5, 9.2; past Q4 guides came in 11-14% above Q3 guides, and FY27 looks like a 53-week year with a 14-week Q4 (my calendar inference, not confirmed by NVIDIA), both pointing to $10.2-10.5B. Actuals have landed slightly under guide, which tempers the number. Median 10.2. Market check: none found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi; bookmakers not checked.
calls.dossier:
- Q2 FY27 press release (Aug 26, 2026): Q3 FY27 GAAP and non-GAAP opex guide approx $9.2B and $9.0B; Q2 GAAP opex actual $8.408B (+10% q/q, +55% y/y). Q2 non-GAAP opex $8.232B (+11% q/q). Q1 FY27 GAAP $7.621B, non-GAAP $7.449B (CFO commentary, SEC 8-K).
- Guide history (GAAP): Q1 FY27 guide 7.7 (actual 7.621); Q2 guide 8.5 (actual 8.408); Q3 guide 9.2. Earlier Q4 guides: Q4 FY26 guide 6.7 vs Q3 FY26 guide 5.9 (+13.6%); Q4 FY25 guide about 4.8 vs Q3 FY25 guide about 4.3 (+11.6%, from memory). Q4 FY26 GAAP actual $6.794B.
- Starting Q1 FY27, non-GAAP includes stock-based compensation; the GAAP minus non-GAAP gap is now about $0.2B. FY26 GAAP opex $23.076B; FY26 old non-GAAP $16.694B plus SBC $6.125B gives about $22.82B restated (Q4 FY26 release).
- Kress, Q2 FY27 call: 'For full year, we now expect OpEx to grow in the low 50s driven by a broadening of our product portfolio and further increase in the usage of AI tools.' The Q1 call (May 2026) said upper 40s, so the outlook was raised once. The basis (GAAP vs non-GAAP) is not stated explicitly.
- Arithmetic: non-GAAP Q1+Q2+Q3guide = 24.68; FY growth of 50/52/54% on 22.82 implies Q4 non-GAAP of 9.55/10.01/10.46; GAAP roughly +0.2. On a GAAP basis (23.076 base, Q1-Q3 = 25.23): 50% gives 9.38, 53% gives 10.08.
- Calendar: FY26 ended Jan 25, 2026; FY27 should end Sunday Jan 31, 2027, making it 53 weeks with a likely 14-week Q4. This is an inference; the Q2 CFO commentary does not mention it.
- Margins expected to bottom in Q4 at 71-72% (Q2 call); FY28 revenue preliminarily guided about +70%.
- Resolves off the 'Outlook' section of the Q3 FY27 press release (Nov 17, 2026), GAAP opex, rounded to $0.1B; not the non-GAAP figure and not actuals.
- Event window: release expected Nov 17, 2026 (single event); as of Nov 6, 2026, nothing has resolved yet.
- Searched without finding: any prediction market (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi) on this figure; sell-side Q4 opex estimates; explicit NVIDIA confirmation of the 53-week year.

calls.reasoning: Recent GAAP opex guides: Q1 7.7, Q2 8.5, Q3 9.2; actuals land ~0.1B under guide, and each new guide is ~0.8-0.9B over the prior quarter's actual. CFO said FY27 opex will grow 'in the low 50s'%; on a FY26 GAAP base of $23.08B and FY27 Q1-Q3 of ~25.2B, that implies Q4 ~9.6-10.1B. Q4 guides in FY25/FY26 stepped up more than the Q3 steps (+12-14%), and NVIDIA has historically outgrown its full-year opex commentary (FY26 'high 30s' turned out ~41%), so the median is tilted to ~10.0. No human prediction market found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi.
calls.dossier:
- Q2 FY27 PR (Aug 26 2026): Q3 FY27 outlook GAAP opex ~$9.2B, non-GAAP ~$9.0B (non-GAAP now includes SBC since FY27). Q2 actual GAAP opex $8.408B (non-GAAP $8.232B), up 10% q/q, driven by compute infrastructure and compensation.
- Q1 FY27 PR (May 2026): Q2 guide GAAP ~$8.5B / non-GAAP ~$8.3B; Q1 actual GAAP $7.621B. Q1 guide (from Q4 FY26 PR, Feb 2026) was GAAP ~$7.7B / non-GAAP ~$7.5B incl. $1.9B SBC.
- Pattern: actuals have landed ~0.08-0.1B under guide in Q1 and Q2 FY27; each new guide has been ~+0.8-0.9B above the prior-quarter actual.
- Q2 FY27 call (Aug 26 2026), CFO Kress: 'For full year, we now expect OPEX to grow in the low 50s' (the word 'now' marks a revision).
- FY26 GAAP opex by quarter: 5.030, 5.413, 5.839, 6.794 = ~$23.08B. Q4 FY26 had been guided ~$6.7B and came in at $6.794B.
- Arithmetic: 51-53% growth on $23.08B = $34.8-35.3B for FY27; minus Q1+Q2 actuals ($16.03B) and Q3 at ~$9.1-9.2B leaves Q4 at ~$9.6-10.1B.
- Q4 seasonality: FY25 GAAP opex guides were Q1 3.5, Q2 4.0, Q3 4.3, Q4 4.8; FY26 guides were 5.2, 5.7, 5.9, 6.7. In both years the Q3-to-Q4 guide step was larger than the Q2-to-Q3 step.
- History of FY growth commentary vs outcome: FY26 opex was guided to 'high 30s' growth; actual GAAP growth was ~41% (FY25 base ~$16.4B).
- Status quo: NVIDIA gives a single 'approximately $X billion' GAAP opex figure each quarter, never a range.
- Resolves off the GAAP opex 'approximately' figure in the Outlook section of the Q3 FY27 press release (Nov 17 2026), rounded to $0.1B. It does not resolve off the non-GAAP figure or off the Q3 actual.
- Event window: single release on 2026-11-17; as of 2026-11-06 the window has not opened.

calls.reasoning: Status quo: NVIDIA keeps raising its quarterly GAAP opex guide by ~$0.7-0.8B per step (7.7, 8.5, 9.2 in FY27; the Q4 FY26 guide was +0.8 over Q3). Actuals ran slightly under guide (Q1 7.62 vs 7.7; Q2 8.41 vs 8.5), so Q3 is likely ~9.1-9.2 and a Q4 guide around 9.9-10.0. Cross-check: 'low 50s' FY27 opex growth on the FY26 GAAP base of 23.08B gives a full year of 34.6-35.5B, which implies Q4 of 9.4-10.3B (GAAP basis) or ~10.0-10.1 if the growth is on a non-GAAP basis. No Kalshi, Polymarket or Manifold market was found.

calls.reasoning: GAAP opex guide steps were 7.7, 8.5, 9.2. The CFO's 'low 50s' FY27 growth implies a Q4 of roughly 9.6-10.1 on a GAAP base or about 10.2 GAAP on a non-GAAP base. FY27 ends Jan 31, 2027, so it is likely a 53-week year with a 14-week Q4, which supports the historical 11-14% Q4 guide step (about 10.2-10.5). Actuals running slightly under guide and plain step-extrapolation (about 9.9-10.0) pull down. Median 10.1. No human prediction market found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi.
calls.reconciliation: Factual: the 53-week year. I checked the calendar myself: Jan 31, 2027 is the last Sunday of January, so FY27 is 53 weeks. That the extra week falls in Q4 rests on my recollection of FY2021, about 75% confidence; this favours Run 1's higher reading over Runs 2 and 3. Factual and unsettled: whether 'low 50s' is a GAAP or non-GAAP basis. I weighted non-GAAP slightly (it implies about 10.2) against GAAP (about 9.85). Judgment: the size of the Q4 seasonal step versus linear steps, and the habit of actuals landing under guide versus the habit of raising full-year growth. Net median 10.1 with a moderately wide band. I carried forward the runs' reference class.
